description: This file defines the IPlugin interface and related classes for plugin management in the Thunder framework, including lifecycle, notification, web, websocket, security, and authentication interfaces.

classes.name: IPlugin
classes.description: Main plugin interface with lifecycle methods and notification/lifetime nested interfaces.

classes.name: IPluginExtended
classes.description: Extended plugin interface supporting WebSocket channel attachment.

classes.name: ICompositPlugin
classes.description: Interface for composite plugins with callback mechanisms.

classes.name: IWeb
classes.description: Interface for handling web requests and responses.

classes.name: IChannel
classes.description: Interface for raw data channel communication.

classes.name: ISecurity
classes.description: Interface for security validation and token management.

classes.name: IAuthenticate
classes.description: Interface for token creation and security officer retrieval.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Called when a plugin is loaded to initialize with configuration.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Called when a plugin is unloaded to clean up.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns metadata information about the plugin.

methods.name: Callback
methods.description: Registers a callback for the composite plugin.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes web requests and returns responses.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles incoming JSON objects on WebSocket.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles incoming JSON objects with identifier.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles raw data received on a channel.

methods.name: Outbound
methods.description: Sends raw data over a channel.

methods.name: Allowed
methods.description: Checks if a websocket upgrade or request is allowed.

methods.name: Officer
methods.description: Retrieves the security officer interface for a token.
